So can anyone tell me the main differences between the two other than popularity?

How does Voat differ from related projects?

  1. based in Switzerland, no censorship policy as long as content is legal in Switzerland
  2. ad revenue sharing model (in development, we will disclose more details soon) where community is rewarded with real money for quality original content deterministically scaling voting quota
  3. limited voting (new users need to gain a certain amount of points before they are able to vote without restrictions)
  4. limited number of owned/moderated subs per user (10)
  5. voat has increased focus on privacy. It enables users to delete their account by automatically overwriting every comment and every submission the user has made with a string "deleted", before proceeding to remove the user account from user credentials database.
  6. built-in night mode
  7. subverse set system similar to the one used on Google News
  8. realtime notifications for user mentions, post and comment replies
  9. realtime chat for every subverse
  10. markdown toolbar for user friendly text editing
  11. automatic expando creation for many popular services
  12. anonymized mode: subverse owners can irreversibly convert their subverse to anonymized mode which hides all usernames and disables all voting actions within that subverse
  13. responsive design which works great on mobile out of the box
  14. user profiles show statistics about user activity, for example, submission distribution and highest-lowest rated submissions and a short biography with avatar
